Title: Workspace decomposition
Purpose: Split the large ProcessWorkspace component code-behind and canvas partial into smaller units so selection, commands, editors, runtime actions, links, and layout concerns stop accumulating in one place.
Deliverables: ProcessWorkspace partial split plan and implementation tasks
Smaller code-behind files grouped by lifecycle, definition CRUD, runtime operations, and canvas commands
Regression coverage for canvas and dialog interactions
ReviewQuestions: Is the UI behavior easier to reason about after the split?
Did event handling and editor orchestration become more explicit?
Are selection, command dispatch, and dialog flows still covered by tests?
CorrectiveOnFailure: Create a workspace corrective subbundle and stop until the UI regression risk is back under control.
